supported_platform: Windows primary (project repository platform); scripts are pure-Python + stdlib and also run on POSIX

scripts.purpose: Start FastAPI backend: artifact validation, port conflict detection, exact uvicorn command, /health readiness polling, Ctrl+C cleanup, exit code propagation
Start Streamlit frontend: backend URL env, port validation, Streamlit start, backend-unreachable warning, Ctrl+C cleanup
Orchestrator: validate → start backend → poll real /health (model_loaded) → start frontend → print URLs → monitor → cleanup own children only
Shared stdlib helpers (port check, health polling, process ownership, graceful teardown)
scripts.usage: imported by the three run scripts

duplicates: existing run.bat remains for backward compatibility; scripts/run_backend.py is the canonical launcher (no 3 duplicate variants)
